cases.question: When did public seed lending begin at Serevin Seed Library?

expected_sources.context: Serevin Seed Library began public seed lending in 1958. The first ventilation fan renewal was completed in 1984; the second ventilation fan renewal was completed in 2011.

cases.question: Who must approve in writing a Korven Instrument Coop purchase above 6200 credits?

expected_sources.context: IC-03. Purchases exceeding 6200 credits require written approval from the Collection Steward and Workshop Treasurer.

cases.question: A Serevin Seed Library dispatch request is released exactly at 14:35. When will it depart, and which hold can block departure?

expected_sources.context: SL-01. Dispatch requests released before 14:35 leave on the current service day. At 14:35 or later, departure is the next service day, unless a phytosanitary hold is open.

unless a phytosanitary hold is open

cases.question: How many seed lots does Beren check per week?

cases.question: When was the Avrel Bell Workshop casting hall restoration completed?

expected_sources.context: The Avrel Bell Workshop casting hall moved in 1912. Its restoration was completed in 1983. A plan to close the mould annex in 2016 was rejected; the annex remains open.

cases.question: How long are Avrel Bell Workshop signed calibration records kept, including the exception for an unresolved material claim?

expected_sources.context: BW-02. Signed calibration records are retained for 4 years. An unresolved material claim extends retention of affected records until the claim is settled.
groups: An unresolved material claim extends retention of affected records until the claim is settled
